faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies in Atal Residential School Banda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 vacancies for Guest Faculty Teacher posts in Atal Residential School Banda Recruitment 2026, across various subjects like TGT English, TGT Social Science, PGT Physics, PGT History, PGT Commerce, and PGT Business Studies.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Guest Faculty Teacher posts?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of the offline application form for Guest Faculty Teacher posts at Atal Residential School Banda is 22 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Guest Faculty Teacher posts in Atal Residential School Banda Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the form, fill it, and send it via post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to these positions?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Guest Faculty Teacher posts should not exceed 50 years of age. There is a maximum age limit of 50 years for all advertised positions.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for Guest Faculty Teacher posts?
faq.answer: The salary for Guest Faculty Teacher posts ranges from Rs. 34125 to Rs. 35750 per month. TGT posts offer Rs. 34125, while PGT posts offer Rs. 35750 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential qualifications for Guest Faculty Teacher posts?
faq.answer: Candidates generally require a Master Degree with 50% marks and B.Ed. with 50% marks, or an Integrated Post Graduate Course with 50% marks, or a Four years integrated degree with 50% marks. Specific qualifications vary by post.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for Atal Residential School Banda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Atal Residential School Banda Recruitment 2026. The application is free of cost.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Guest Faculty Teacher positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for Guest Faculty Teacher posts at Atal Residential School Banda involves an Interview, followed by the preparation of a Merit List. Candidates will be selected based on their performance.
